name: opsgenie_manage
description: Manage Opsgenie alerts, incidents, on-call schedules, and escalation policies via the Opsgenie REST API v2. Supports alert lifecycle (create, get, list, acknowledge, close, snooze, add notes/tags), incident management (create, get, list, close, add responder, add timeline entry), on-call schedule queries, and escalation policy lookups.

parameters.name: action
parameters.description: The operation to perform.

parameters.name: --alert_id
parameters.description: Alert identifier (ID, tinyId, or alias). Required for single-alert operations.

parameters.name: --identifier_type
parameters.description: Type of alert identifier.

parameters.name: --incident_id
parameters.description: Incident identifier. Required for single-incident operations.

parameters.name: --message
parameters.description: Alert message (max 130 chars). Required for create_alert.

parameters.name: --alias
parameters.description: Unique de-duplication key for alerts (max 512 chars).

parameters.name: --description
parameters.description: Detailed description (max 15000 chars).

parameters.name: --priority
parameters.description: Alert/incident priority.

parameters.name: --responders
parameters.description: Comma-separated responder identifiers (team:TeamName, user:username, schedule:ScheduleName, escalation:EscName). Max 50.

parameters.name: --tags
parameters.description: Comma-separated tags (max 20 tags, each max 50 chars).

parameters.name: --details
parameters.description: JSON string of key-value custom properties (max 8000 chars total).

parameters.name: --entity
parameters.description: Related domain entity name (max 512 chars).

parameters.name: --source
parameters.description: Alert source (max 100 chars). Defaults to "ai-sre".

parameters.name: --note
parameters.description: Additional note text (max 25000 chars). Used with add_note and other actions.

parameters.name: --user
parameters.description: Display name of the request owner (max 100 chars).

parameters.name: --assignee
parameters.description: User to assign the alert to. Used with assign_alert.

parameters.name: --snooze_until
parameters.description: ISO 8601 datetime for snooze end time. Required for snooze_alert.

parameters.name: --schedule_id
parameters.description: Schedule identifier. Required for get_on_call.

parameters.name: --escalation_id
parameters.description: Escalation policy identifier.

parameters.name: --query
parameters.description: Search query for list_alerts (Opsgenie query syntax). Example: "status=open AND priority=P1".

parameters.name: --limit
parameters.description: Max results to return for list operations (max 100).

parameters.name: --offset
parameters.description: Pagination offset for list operations.

parameters.name: --sort
parameters.description: Sort field for list operations.

parameters.name: --order
parameters.description: Sort order.

parameters.name: --region
parameters.description: Opsgenie data residency region.

parameters.name: --dry_run
parameters.description: Validate the request without executing. Returns what would happen.

parameters.name: --service_name
parameters.description: Affected service name for incident creation.

parameters.name: --timeline_entry
parameters.description: Timeline entry text for add_timeline_entry.

returns: JSON object with fields: {"ok": bool, "request_id": string, "data": object, "message": string}. For async write operations, data includes the requestId for status polling.
examples: opsgenie_manage create_alert --message "High CPU on web-server-01" --priority P2 --responders "team:SRE,user:jdoe" --tags "cpu,production" --entity web-server-01
opsgenie_manage acknowledge_alert --alert_id abc-123 --note "Investigating — AI SRE triage"
opsgenie_manage close_alert --alert_id abc-123 --note "Resolved: CPU normalized after pod restart"
opsgenie_manage add_note --alert_id abc-123 --note "Root cause: memory leak in v2.3.1"
opsgenie_manage escalate_alert --alert_id abc-123 --escalation_id esc-policy-1 --note "Escalating to L2"
opsgenie_manage create_incident --message "Service outage: payments-api" --priority P1 --service_name payments-api --description "Complete service unavailability"
